## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text combines a verse-hymn (*sòng* 頌) by [本嵩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E5%B5%A9) Běnsōng on the *Avataṃsaka*'s title and on the *Fǎ jiè guānmén* doctrine, with prose annotation by [琮湛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%90%AE%E6%B9%9B) Cóngzhàn. The format — devotional verse plus explanatory prose — was popular in Northern Sòng Buddhist literature, providing accessible material for both monastic recitation and lay study.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1080 – 1130) reflects the late-Northern-Sòng period during which the *sòngzhù* genre flourished. The work is part of the wider Sòng Huìyīnsì Huáyán-school revival project (cf. [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's *[Huán yuán guān kē](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0091)*, *[Huáyán jīng shū kē](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0017)*, etc.), providing devotional-pedagogical material derived from the foundational Tang Huáyán doctrinal corpus.

The Taishō text (T1885) is established on the standard apparatus.
